mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion, while piroxicam reduces renal perfusion through inhibition of prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation, synergistically increasing acute kidney injury risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely (baseline and frequent BUN/creatinine), maintain adequate hydration, and consider alternative NSAIDs or discontinue piroxicam during amphotericin B therapy.
